note: Relayed by the dispatch planner from the lane's scratchpad report (lane cannot write into this worktree).

designDecisions.item1_setbacksZoningFromReader: Additive post-process after adaptAtomChainToBakedFacets and the cortex merge; overrides facets.zoning/envelope.setbacks ONLY for the specific reader rail whose serve==='record', leaving envelope.status/geojson/buildableArea and every legacy-transitional axis untouched (R-2 mechanism). For 48021 today: zoningDistrict+setbackFrontFt serve record; side/rear/corner serve legacy-transitional (expected, not a defect).
designDecisions.item3_readerOutageDeclaredNotSilent: On /record failure, applyRecordPatch now sets readPath 'record-unavailable' (new state, not a widened check) and returns typed refusals for exactly the fields item 1/item 4 would have set on success -- nothing wider.
designDecisions.item2_dollarRailsAndOwnerGatedInBff: DEFERRED at CP1: reusing requireStudioSession's gate decision inside the facets handler is a real, non-trivial change to a route every panel load calls, and abuts 'the entitlement gate is not yours to change'. No live back-channel existed to receive review mid-task, so the lane defaulted to NOT building it and naming the deferral explicitly.
designDecisions.item4_reportComposerReadsReader: New reader client in hauska-engine composeParcelReportFacts, reusing the RETRIEVAL_API_URL/KEY env-var names pe-property-atoms.ts already checks (no new secret). Purely additive; substrate-atom/constant path remains the fallback, declared not silent.
designDecisions.item5_entitlementTravels: Open question flagged: whether an unsigned x-hauska-access-tier header is an acceptable trust boundary or needs a signed claim. Proceeding on the existing-trust-boundary reading; will stop and report if wrong rather than invent a signing scheme.
designDecisions.item6_vacancyGuardBothInputs: Once item 4's roll values are reader-backed, the existing footprintContradictsAppraisal guard fires with no new guard logic needed.
designDecisions.item7_specialDistrictReconciliation: Reader's specialDistricts rail composes when serve==='record'; substrate TCEQ atoms listed beside it, labelled, only when transitional/absent or disagreeing -- disagreement reported, never silently resolved.

falsifier: If after both deploys the panel facets and get_smart_site disagree on setbacks, zoning, values, city limits or special district for any probe parcel where the reader serves 'record', or the feasibility PDF for 48453:474034 still prints UNAVAILABLE beside the card's dollars or the city-limits constant, or an anonymous read shows a studio-gated value, or a simulated reader 503 yields an atom-chain value with HTTP 200, the change is wrong.
